description: Source code for C++ JIT compilation utilities within PyTorch's benchmarking framework, including functions for compiling C++ code templates, managing build roots, and interfacing with external C++ extensions.

methods.name: _get_build_root
methods.description: Returns the build root directory, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: get_compat_bindings
methods.description: Loads and returns the Callgrind compatibility bindings extension.

methods.name: _compile_template
methods.description: Compiles a C++ code template with provided setup and statement strings.

methods.name: compile_timeit_template
methods.description: Compiles a timeit C++ template into a Python module.

methods.name: compile_callgrind_template
methods.description: Compiles a callgrind C++ template into a string representing the target path.
